mapping.summary: Rule-based multi-level allocation of costs and revenue
claims: Allocates and reallocates revenue as well as expenses across dimensions and G/L accounts
Uses BC statistical accounts as allocation drivers (hours, revenue, headcount, quantities, custom)
Rule-based picking of source transactions by base dimension and G/L account
Supports multi-level cascading allocations (department to employee to project)
Generates allocation results into the General Journal for review before posting
Traces allocated targets back to source amounts, keeping dimensions
Allocates to any dimension, cost center, department or project
Redistributes payroll and shared expenses by timesheet hours or revenue contribution
